**White UI with Black Text Proposal** **Overview** ------------ This proposal outlines the changes required to implement a white UI with black text for our application, while maintaining the existing system architecture. **Changes to System Architecture** --------------------------------- The system architecture remains unchanged, as only the visual aspects of the application are being modified. The following components will be updated: * Frontend Components: All frontend components (e.g., `App.jsx`, `DrugGraph.jsx`) will have their UI changed to white with black text. * Backend Engines and Services: No changes are required for backend engines and services, as they do not affect the visual appearance of the application. **Implementation Plan** ---------------------- 1. **Update Frontend Components** * Open each frontend component (e.g., `App.jsx`, `DrugGraph.jsx`) in a code editor. * Update the CSS styles to change the background color to white and text color to black. * Save changes to each file. 2. **Verify Changes** * Run the application to verify that all frontend components have been updated with a white UI and black text. **Example Code Snippet** ---------------------- For example, in `App.jsx`, you can update the CSS styles as follows: ```jsx import React from 'react'; import './App.css'; function App() { return (
{/* Application content */}
); } export default App; ``` In `App.css`, add the following styles to change the background color and text color: ```css .app-container { background-color: #FFFFFF; /* White */ color: #000000; /* Black */ } ``` **Conclusion** ---------- By implementing these changes, we will achieve a white UI with black text for our application while maintaining the existing system architecture.
